name: Stance
description: Register trading decisions before outcomes are known. The server timestamps, prices, replays, and scores them without broker credentials.

body.strategy: stable ASCII identifier: A-Z, a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore, hyphen

registration.api_key: Returned once as api_key. Never print it in chat or logs. Store it outside the repository with mode 0600 or in a secret manager.

body.seq: positive integer; recover with GET /portfolio last_seq + 1

agent_rules: Inspect the repository before proposing registration metadata.
Do not migrate or backfill historical trades.
If positions already exist, declare only their current target weights from the connection time onward.
Never expose the API key in chat, logs, commits, patches, screenshots, or command output.
Keep secrets outside the repository with mode 0600, or use the project's existing secret manager.
Ensure secret files are ignored before writing them.
Use one declaration writer per strategy.
On timeout, retry the identical seq and body; never allocate a new seq until the result is known.
Keep Stance reporting fail-open and separate from live order execution.
Verify health, authenticated portfolio recovery, and one non-mutating validation path before reporting completion.
